rationale: Deterministic, zero extra LLM calls, and produces a number comparable across --model runs, which is the stated reason the dsl runner exists; per-task semantic grading (Option B) reintroduces nondeterminism and cannot distinguish a wrong model answer from a wrong judge verdict.
alternatives_rejected: Per-task semantic grading (synthesize a --semantic criterion from expected and call evaluate_llm_structured once per task)
